name: Pemmin's Aura — activated abilities are not static effects
notes: Memory: project_activated_aura_fixes_2026-04-21 (Bug 1). The '{U}: Enchanted creature gains flying' and '{1}: Enchanted creature gets +1/-1' lines were parsed as static effects, so the enchanted creature got flying and shroud for free. Grizzly Bears enchanted with Pemmin's Aura must stay a 2/2 with neither Flying nor Shroud; the Aura has no static add_ability effect (its only modify_pt is the inert 0/0 attachment tracker, so a static +1/-1 would show as 3/1).
